summary: JM Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the issuance of a promissory note by its wholly owned subsidiary, JM Manufacturing (HK) Limited, in favor of CEO and major shareholder Chun Kwok Stanley Ting for up to HK$15,065,000 (approx. $1.93M USD). The note is non-interest-bearing, matures on May 31, 2033, and is drawn down for working capital. No special-situation transaction such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is indicated; this is a routine financing arrangement between related parties.
